_note: REAL BUSINESS. Facts taken from emergencyplumbinghero.com and their public Google listing on 2026-10-25. Nothing invented. They publish no prices and no street address, so both are in `unknowns` and the agent says the office will confirm. Re-check before go-live.
_evidence: 1-star, edited 6 months ago: 'A no show when they told me they'd be here between 10-2pm. Would not answer their phones would not answer text messages.' The owner's public reply explains why: 'The nature of our business prioritizes emergency calls and we were regretfully stuck helping... so the hose bib you requested became lower priority.' 45 Google reviews at 4.9 against Bumble Bee's 4,389 in the same market.

tone: Calm and fast. People reaching this business are often standing in water at 3am and frightened. Their best reviews describe Tom talking a panicking customer down and arriving in fifteen minutes. Steady, no fuss, no upselling, and never make an emergency caller wait through small talk.
